name: CoBa's Daughter Q4 monthly content system
planning_note: Content counts are planning weights, not performance forecasts. Evergreen is the quarter floor; Occasions is the seasonal growth curve.

pillars.name: Evergreen body care
angles: Integrate it into a real body routine
Earn the right to recommend it as a gift

pillars.name: The Gift Guide
angles: Abundance that solves the whole gift list
Be the first to edit the season's best sets

pillars.name: The Aesop Alternative
angles: Gift the discovery she has not seen
Earn the right to recommend it as a gift

pillars.name: The Occasions
angles: Abundance that solves the whole gift list

sep.name: September
sep.focus: Aesop Alternative plus a truthful reason to buy early
sep.cta: Discover the ritual early; use directional CTA only until bundles are finalized.
sep.inventory: Send 100 TikTok samples. Basket leaves warehouse in week 4.

oct.name: October
oct.focus: Gift Guide, Keepsake, hostess and early occasions
oct.cta: Shop the gift section; explain the real value of buying multiples.

nov.name: November
nov.focus: Hostess through Nov 20, volume bundles and first truthful promotion captions
allowed_language: one for them, one for me
nov.cta: One for them, one for me; show the real bundle math on screen.
nov.inventory: Double Kimie's basket posts; move three posts to volume. Use real stock and promotion data only.

dec.name: December
dec.focus: Secret Santa, White Elephant and year-end parties
dec.cta: Buy in multiples and order before December 18 when the confirmed shipping cutoff applies.
dec.inventory: Everything must ship before Dec 18. Use deadline only while operationally true.

streams.name: Arie
streams.brief_depth: Basket deep dive; TikTok Shop controls only CTA, 2/3 Scrub–1/3 Aloe product ratio and sample count.
hard_limits: Do not script a precise cut when only generic B-roll is guaranteed
Use QA gates for hook, format, script and hashtags

streams.name: Louie
streams.brief_depth: Deepest brief stream and first place to test new angles. Gifting exceeds evergreen from October.
hard_limits: Claims and CTA must remain Amazon-compatible

streams.name: Kimie
streams.brief_depth: Can publish $80 basket stories without inventory, but cannot shoot physical-product proof.

streams.name: New intern
streams.brief_depth: Routine integration plus growing gifting round-ups. Line is capped at 15 posts per month until the role is filled.
hard_limits: If role is unfilled, cap at 15 posts
Gifting round-ups grow from 5 to 13 posts

hard_rules: Never say CoBa smells like Aesop. Compare only price position, packaging and texture.
Never use fake urgency. Only use the confirmed Dec 18 cutoff, truthful inventory or visible bundle math.
Do not use an unconfirmed bundle or set name. Until finalized, CTA is direction rather than a quoted price or product name.
